text: These geniuses robbed a train, then got busted by ketchup.
England, August nineteen sixty-three. Now picture a Royal Mail train, the post office train, rolling through the night.
It's carrying sacks of used banknotes. And guess who wants them? A gang of about fifteen men.
Step one: they rig a railway signal, so the driver thinks he has to stop.
Double-tap if you'd fall for a rigged signal too.
Step two: they grab a hundred and twenty mail sacks.
Inside is about two point six million pounds.
That's two and a half tons of cash. Heavier than a damn car.
Step three: they hide out at a farmhouse to lie low.
And how do these legends kill time? Monopoly, with the real stolen cash.
Then they wipe the whole place down, so there's no trace.
Send this to the friend who'd play Monopoly with stolen money.
But the plan was to burn the farmhouse too. Reportedly, that never happened.
Then a tip sends police straight to the farm.
Police find fingerprints on the Monopoly board, and on a ketchup bottle.
Yeah. They wiped the whole farm but forgot the ketchup.
Follow if you live for watching master plans eat shit.
In April nineteen sixty-four, a court convicted most of the gang.
The main men got sentenced to up to thirty years in prison.
Two and a half tons of cash, and the ketchup bottle snitched.
Monopoly or ketchup, which one's the dumber move?
